notes.title: Atari Podcast Episode 26 - NeoSprint w/ Headless Chicken
notes.content:
[i]Atari Podcast episode 26 was originally uploaded April 12th, 2024. [/i]

It's official: NeoSprint is out of VCS Early Access and available on all platforms! What better time to see what's changed since the start of the early access period? And who better to do so than the head of developer Headless Chicken, Jose Pablo Monge Chacon (JP), and Atari's senior art director, John Kauderer, a creative driver on the title?

Watch the discussion below:

[previewyoutube=mJawSuLf04w;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: NeoSprint is Available Now!
notes.content:
NeoSprint races onto Steam today! Check out the launch trailer below:

[previewyoutube=tCjZml5gUBw;full][/previewyoutube]
As a special surprise for Steam users, the game will be available at a 10% discount for the first two weeks of launch! Grab your friends, build some tracks, and start your engines!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2217910/NeoSprint

The exhilarating Atari racing classic “Sprint” series returns with NeoSprint. NeoSprint zooms back to life as a single screen arcade racer for up to 8 players, paired with a robust track builder and intuitive sharing tools, ensuring a racing experience that satisfies speed demons and architects alike. Campaign mode, Grand Prix, Obstacle Courses and Time Trials provide tons of pulse-pounding race content, and multiplayer modes make for chaotic fun. Can you conquer the speedways and claim the fastest times?
